notes: CfA's /people page is a JS 'Load More' infinite-scroll search with no static roster and no sitemap.xml shortcut found; Playwright timed out waiting for it to settle (networkidle never reached, likely due to continuous background requests from the search widget). Could not enumerate individual scientists/PIs in this pass. Recorded CfA's organizational structure from the people page instead, for a future deeper pass: Science is organized into six divisions (Atomic and Molecular Physics; Radio and Geoastronomy; High Energy Astrophysics; Optical and Infrared Astronomy; Solar, Stellar, and Planetary Sciences; Theoretical Astrophysics), plus the Science Education Department and the Harvard University Department of Astronomy (= targets.csv's separate harvard-astronomy row, itself Akamai-blocked this round), plus three named centers: Chandra X-Ray Center (CXC), Institute for Theoretical Atomic, Molecular and Optical Physics (ITAMP), and Institute for Theory and Computation (ITC, https://itc.cfa.harvard.edu/ per the targets.csv note). A future pass should try each division's or center's own page directly (e.g. an ITC-specific people page) rather than the site-wide /people search.
